name: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down on the machine, knees just off the bench edge.
Set the pad just above your heels and hold the handles.
Curl your heels toward your glutes as far as you comfortably can.
Pause and squeeze the back of your thighs.
Lower slowly until legs are nearly straight.

common_mistakes.fix: Lighten the load and keep hips pressed down
Lower until legs are nearly straight each rep
Lift with control and pause at the top
